description: This file defines a Swift enum `LaunchAgentManager` that manages macOS launch agents. It provides functions to check the status of a launch agent, enable or disable it, generate its plist contents, and execute launchctl commands asynchronously.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Checks if the launch agent is currently active by executing a launchctl print command and returns a boolean asynchronously.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent based on the `enabled` parameter, writing or removing the plist accordingly, and managing the launch agent via launchctl commands asynchronously.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Creates and writes the launch agent plist file at a specified URL with given bundle path.

methods.name: plistContents
methods.description: Generates the XML content of the launch agent plist based on provided bundle path, including environment variables and paths.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Runs the launchctl command asynchronously with given arguments and returns the process exit code.
